citations.name: habeas:coverage
citations.commentary:
This edge-only validation regression deliberately supplies no node
 contents. Its records assert selection dependencies only. Graph
 requires this callback, but reaching it would introduce an unwanted
 content read and fail this guard.

rationale:
The `habeas:coverage` citation is on an explicit function with a body, `node_content` in `impl[GraphWithChangingEdges/Graph]`, and the justification sits in fenced commentary. That matches the built-in's permitted form.

The reason is substantive and fits the source:
- `Graph::node_content` in `crates/habeas-sdk/src/graph.rs` is a required trait method, so the test graph has to define it.
- The enclosing test `agent_edge_tools_record_selections_without_validating_targets` is edge-only. It asserts that the recorded dependencies are just `Dependency::OutgoingEdges`, with no content dependency.
- The `panic!` body is a deliberate guard. It fails the test if any content read happens, so the function is not meant to run, and that is why it has zero execution coverage.
- The `Validation::validate` implementation calls only `ctx.ask`, and the scripted agent calls only `outgoing_edges` and `submit_result`. Nothing in the test legitimately reaches `node_content`.

The citation excuses only this function's zero execution. No file threshold is claimed.
